title: The review record's head check ignores a head whose only change since the recorded head is docs/records.md pushed by the merge tool's own --ready
why: The merge tool's `merge --ready` pushes a records-page commit, which moves the head and makes the review record read stale. Each PR then needs a fix verifier over a records-only commit. Cases today: #3302 at 81eaca3ad313 and #3269 at b4078a223be3d3e625399969b3a817a869256d7f (coordinator 21:07 CST).
source: Coordinator 21:07 CST Nov 13; the cases are its word, unchecked by triage.
note: Triage 21:07 CST Nov 13: checked for a cover. No step names this exactly. Near: records-page-before-ready (doing: one CI run per merge, the records page rebuilt before the ready run), fix-check-records-carry (doing: a FAIL on a records-only diff carries), fix-check-after-main-merge (done). The lane may fold into records-page-before-ready if its fix already moves the push before the record. Fix to propose: the record head check ignores a head whose only change since the recorded head is docs/records.md pushed by the tool itself; red case first. Tracker the coordinator; path alone via runner 10.
